variants.description: p=1 heavy_hex ZNE seed=42 (hardware deployment validation)
variants.hypothesis: p=1 heavy_hex ZNE with seed=42 achieves positive gain. CX count for p=1 heavy_hex N=10 = 18 (at threshold). Key advantage: zero SWAP overhead on IBM Torino hardware.
variants.expected_outcome: PASS expected — p=1 heavy_hex has same CX count as chain_1d p=1 (both 18 CX), and chain_1d ZNE works (+46% gain). The real advantage is zero SWAP routing on hardware.
